div.head: EGu 10
div.ab: Gyf limlǽpeo lama, ðe forworht wære, weorðe forlæten, ⁊ he æfter ðam ðreo niht alibbe, siððan man mot hylpan be bisceopes leafe, se ðe wylle beorgan sare ⁊ saule.
Gif limlæweo lama, þe forworht wære, weorþe forlæten, ⁊ he æfter þam ðreo niht alibbe, siððan man mot hylpan be bisceopes leafe, se ðe wylle beorgan sare ⁊ saule.
Si limeþeo lama, qui forisfactus esset, dimittatur et ipse uiuat tres noctes, potest ei deinceps subueniri per episcopi licentiam, si quis uelit.
Gif limlæweo lama, þe forworht wære, weorþe forlæten, ⁊ he æfter þam ðreo niht alibbe, siððan man mot hylpan be bisceopes leafe, se ðe wylle beorgan sare ⁊ saule.

If a criminal who has been mutilated and maimed is abandoned, and three days later he is still alive, after this time [has elapsed] he who wishes to have regard to his wounds and his soul may help him with the permission of the bishop.

Wenn ein an Gliedern verstümmelter Krüppel, der [zur Hinrichtung] verurtheilt war, verlassen wird und nach dem drei Tage überlebt, dann darf mit des Bischofs Erlaubniss jemand [ihm] helfen, wer der Wunde und der Seele Rettung bringen will.

If a cripple mutilated in his limbs, who had been condemned [to execution], is abandoned and survives three days after that, then anyone who wishes to bring help to the wound and the soul may help [him] with the bishop’s permission.
